evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any stress or concerns about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'no, we've moved many times.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Both the estimate-variability framing and the self-prep tip landed clearly. No rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Handled a customer request for artwork/valuables labeling thoughtfully, flagging items for extra care without being asked twice.
coaching_note: The customer wants to compare with another provider before deciding — the rep offered an easy email follow-up rather than pushing, which is the right call here, but there was no attempt to find out what would tip the decision in Einstein's favor.
